extracted.intended_audience: philanthropic organizations, foundation staff, and prospective Council members
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes the Council on Foundations' vision, mission, and core beliefs that define professional and ethical expectations for philanthropic organizations and foundation professionals. Useful as a normative checklist for organizational behavior, transparency, collaboration, and talent development in grantmaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision: Philanthropy as trusted partner
rubrics_metrics.description: Philanthropy is a trusted partner in advancing the greater good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States the Council's overarching aspirational standard for the field; serves as a high-level goal for philanthropic legitimacy and public trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: Foster environment and cultivate professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council on Foundations fosters an environment where philanthropy can thrive and cultivates a community of diverse and skilled philanthropic professionals and organizations who lead with integrity, serve as ethical stewards and advocate for progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines expected organizational behaviors: cultivating diversity and skills, leading with integrity, ethical stewardship, and advocacy for progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for member organizations to advance impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports over 1,000 member organizations ... to build trust in philanthropy, expand pathways to giving, engage broader perspectives, and co-create solutions that will lead to a better future for all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions services and activities (knowledge sharing, pathways to giving, engagement, co-creation) as mechanisms by which members should pursue greater impact; implies the Council offers membership benefits toward these ends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Role of philanthropy
rubrics_metrics.description: Philanthropy plays a critical role in strengthening diverse civil society and supporting communities where everyone thrives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames philanthropic activity as oriented toward strengthening civil society and equitable community outcomes; implies grantmaking should target system-strengthening and inclusive thriving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Community and knowledge sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: By fostering a community of philanthropic leaders who generously share knowledge and resources, build trusting relationships and engage in challenging conversations across difference, we can enhance the impact of grantmakers across the U.S. and around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values peer learning, trust-building, resource sharing, and cross-difference dialogue as practices that improve grantmaker effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Integrity and ethical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Public trust in philanthropy expands when our field demonstrates high professional and ethical standards, integrates perspectives from those most affected by our decisions and commits to continual learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls for high professional/ethical standards, meaningful stakeholder integration (those most affected), and ongoing learning as criteria for legitimate philanthropic practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Awareness and public policy understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: A more robust understanding of philanthropy by policy makers and the public helps create the supportive policy environment needed to expand individual and institutional giving in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages efforts to improve public and policymaker awareness of philanthropy as part of enabling a favorable policy context for giving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Collaboration and multi-sector partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage and support multi-sector collaboration and partnerships as philanthropy works to address systemic issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endorses collaboration across sectors as a preferred approach for addressing systemic challenges; implies grantmaking should prioritize partnership-oriented strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core belief — Talent and workforce development
rubrics_metrics.description: Philanthropic organizations are continually expanding their knowledge and understanding of how change happens. To realize the full promise of philanthropy and keep pace with community needs, a diverse, empathetic and skilled workforce is essential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies expectations around continual organizational learning and investing in a diverse, empathetic, skilled workforce as a quality criterion for philanthropy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public disclosure and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: In the spirit of transparency, we make available to the public our audited financial statements and our 990.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes a transparency practice: publishing audited financials and IRS Form 990s; implies public financial disclosure is a standard for trustworthy philanthropic organizations.
